listings.title: In-calf Friesian heifer
listings.description: Calm, well-handled heifer raised on a zero-grazing unit. The seller reports she is about five months in calf. Buyers are encouraged to arrange a veterinary check during the viewing.

listings.description: Second-lactation Ayrshire kept on Napier grass and dairy meal. Milking records are available from the seller on request and can be reviewed before any commitment.

listings.title: Boran steer for finishing
listings.description: Range-raised Boran steer in good body condition, used to rotational grazing. Suitable for feedlot finishing. Transport is arranged separately between buyer and seller.

listings.description: Mature Boran bull that has run with a commercial herd. The seller can share calving records from his offspring. A breeding soundness exam by your own vet is recommended.
